decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is a new generation of the firm's core marking technology, so its in-house inkjet and ink expertise lets it interpret field results and keep improving the product.
The numbering software module extends the firm's variable-data printing portfolio and supports its serialization strategy, and it draws on software knowledge the firm already holds.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces builds directly on the firm's ink chemistry and printhead know-how, which lets it assimilate customer feedback and refine the product through its own R&D.

The CodeScan app is low-cost, already succeeded an earlier app and supports traceability, but mobile apps lie further from the firm's hardware core and are more likely to be renamed or replaced, so the drop risk is moderate.
Inline code verification complements the firm's coding systems and is central to compliance and end-to-end traceability, so related knowledge supports keeping and developing it.
The layout design software provides common operation across the firm's systems and fits its digitalization direction, so it is a strategic, low-maintenance product worth keeping.
